solution.title: Device Enrollment, Identity Association & Asset Inventory (Intune)

products.name: Device Enrollment, Identity Association & Asset Inventory (Intune) — Commercial
products.short_description: Establish clean device enrollment, identity association, and asset inventory in Microsoft Intune — the right enrollment methods, correct primary-user association, and a reconciled inventory the service desk can trust. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Every device enrolled, tied to the right user, and accounted for in inventory

A service desk can't support what it can't see. When devices aren't reliably enrolled, aren't associated with the right primary user, and aren't tracked in an accurate inventory, every ticket starts with detective work and assets quietly go missing. This solution establishes clean device enrollment, identity association, and asset inventory in Microsoft Intune — the right enrollment methods, correct primary-user/device-identity association, and an accurate, reconciled inventory the service desk can trust.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the enrollment methods (Autopilot, Entra join + auto-enrollment, bulk/DEM, BYOD), primary-user and device-identity association, and the Intune inventory model as the service desk's source of truth.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, enrollment restrictions and auto-enrollment, identity/primary-user model, an inventory reconciliation source) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: configure enrollment methods and restrictions, set auto-enrollment, establish primary-user association rules, enroll/import devices, reconcile inventory, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — enrollment/identity discovery, per-device enrollment and primary-user validation, an inventory reconciliation and gap report, safe remediation (fix primary-user/stale records, -WhatIf default), and a device-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every device enrolled, tied to the right user, and accounted for in a reconciled Intune inventory — so the service desk starts every ticket with the facts — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ENROLLID-Discovery.ps1 — enrollment posture and primary-user coverage across the fleet (Microsoft Graph)
    • ENROLLID-Remediation.ps1 — safely fix a device's primary user or retire a stale record (Microsoft Graph)
    • ENROLLID-Report.ps1 — inventory reconciliation against a "should exist" list, with gap analysis (Microsoft Graph)
    • ENROLLID-Set-DeviceScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/maintain device-scope targeting groups (Microsoft Graph)
    • ENROLLID-Validation.ps1 — confirm a device is enrolled and check its primary-user association (Microsoft Graph)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
